build_find_matches: build a call to _find_matches that matches FX graph nodes against quantization patterns and returns a match map
test_is_match: test _is_match against a node and pattern to verify whether the node satisfies the quantization pattern
create_match_all_node: create a MatchAllNode subclass that matches any FX graph node regardless of its operation type
review_match_result: review the _MatchResult tuple type alias containing node, matched values, pattern, and QuantizeHandler
summarize_find_matches: summarize _find_matches which traverses an FX graph in reverse to find quantization pattern matches
